name: Memco Personal Memory
description:
Memco Personal Memory gives your AI assistants persistent memory about how you work. Preferences, habits, project context, and working style carry across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any other MCP-compatible client. Every agent starts where the last one left off.

Your memories are private, hosted, and fully under your control. The Memco dashboard at memco.ai lets you view, edit, and delete individual memories at any time. There is no local setup, no file to manage, and no data locked inside a single tool.

Memco Personal Memory works alongside Memco Shared Memory. Personal memory holds what is yours: how you like responses formatted, your editor setup, your role and working context. Shared memory holds what your team should know: validated solutions, operational decisions, institutional knowledge. Same platform, complementary scopes. Use one or both.

Free to use. Sign up at memco.ai.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Memco Personal Memory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Memco Personal Memory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://spark.memco.ai/mcp-personal. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Memco Personal Memory MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Memco Personal Memory provides these MCP tools: delete_memory, get_memory, list_memories, search, start_session, update_memory, and write_memory.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Memco Personal Memory?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Memco Personal Memory in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Memco Personal Memory MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Memco Personal Memory requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Memco Personal Memory is developed by Memco AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
